patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ocean.io and Seamless.AI share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Ocean.io only if your buying job matches “Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/cr” rather than Seamless.AI's shape. Choose Seamless.AI only if your buying job matches “High-volume B2B contact and sales intelligence platform with freemium entry, Chrome prospe” rather than Ocean.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Ocean.io leans lead-management; Seamless.AI leans email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ocean.io and Seamless.AI share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Ocean.io is Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/credit, ~$47/mo yearly headline.; Seamless.AI is High-volume B2B contact and sales intelligence platform with freemium entry, Chrome prospecting, and CRM sync — Pro/Enterprise quote-led..
- Workflow coverage skew: Ocean.io-leaning lead-management vs Seamless.AI-leaning email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Ocean.io — Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Seamless.AI — Pro and Enterprise list prices are often quote-led rather than fully self-serve published dollars.

Limitations — Ocean.io: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Credit minimums and yearly packaging require modeling before comparing to seat tools; Seamless.AI: Pro and Enterprise list prices are often quote-led rather than fully self-serve published dollars; Data accuracy still requires buyer verification workflows — not a lab-audited guarantee.

Poor-fit cases: Ocean.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer · Seamless.AI is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pro and Enterprise list prices are often quote-led rather than fully self-serve published dollars · Avoid Ocean.io if you actually need Seamless.AI's motion (High-volume B2B contact and sales intelligence platform with freemium entry, Chr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
